+    """Return the center of a saturated blue task object, in image pixels."""
+    rgb = img.astype(np.int16)
+    m = (rgb[:, :, 2] > 100) & (rgb[:, :, 2] > rgb[:, :, 0] + 50) & (rgb[:, :, 2] > rgb[:, :, 1] + 50)
+    y, x = np.where(m)
+    if not len(x):

+

+def green_centroid(img: np.ndarray):
+    rgb = img.astype(np.int16)
+    m = (rgb[:, :, 1] > 220) & (rgb[:, :, 0] < 60) & (rgb[:, :, 2] < 60)
+    y, x = np.where(m)
+    if not len(x):
+        return None
+    return np.array([float(np.mean(x)), float(np.mean(y))])
+
+
+def report(obs, tag):
+    print(f"\n--- {tag} ---")
+    print("control_steps", obs.meta.get("control_steps"), "time_left_s", obs.meta.get("time_left_s"))
+    print("proprio", np.array(obs.meta["proprio"]["now"][:7]).round(4).tolist())
+    print("target", obs.meta["task"]["target_pos"])
+    for cam, img in obs.last.items():
+        b = blue_centroid(img)
+        g = green_centroid(img)
+        print(cam, "blue", b, "green", g)
+

+def move_to(r: Robot, xyz, grip=-1.0, note="move"):
+    """Move the native mocap target in small, bounded increments."""
+    state = r.get_obs(cameras=[], include_depth=False)
+    p = np.asarray(state.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=float)
+    here = p[4:7].copy()
+    dest = np.asarray(xyz, dtype=float)
+    # A 0.4 action advances the target 4 mm per native control step.
+    while np.max(np.abs(dest - here)) > 1e-6:
+        delta = dest - here
+        n = max(1, int(math.ceil(np.max(np.abs(delta)) / 0.004)))
+        n = min(n, 800)
+        inc = delta / n
+        actions = np.zeros((n, 4), dtype=np.float64)
+        actions[:, :3] = inc / 0.01
+        actions[:, 3] = grip
